title: Can You Swim With Dolphins in Madeira?
description: Only on a licensed trip, with common or Atlantic spotted dolphins only: up to four swimmers keep hold of a line from the boat. Any other swim is banned.
heroAlt: Two common dolphins surfacing side by side in deep blue Atlantic water off Madeira
